# Bid the opening, the cut, and the extras.

> Price an egress window from window count, hopper versus slider versus casement versus fiberglass, retrofit versus wood-cut versus masonry-cut versus poured-cut, plastic versus steel versus stone well, extras, and weekday versus Saturday — plus the walk-away price a $1,800 installed special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
